$note: Frontend budgets for the `web-perf` gate (F-049). ADR-0021 asked for these in F-028 and they were never enforced — documentation, not a gate. Now they fail. A miss is a code-splitting job or a registered work item; it is never a raised number here.
$firstLoadNote: Measured OVER THE WIRE and gzipped by the harness itself (zlib), not read from the build output: Next 16/Turbopack stopped printing first-load JS in the route table (see the turbopack-route-table-no-first-load-js lesson), and server-side compression settings must not change what we claim. Captured at the `load` event and NOT at networkidle — 'First Load JS' is what the route needs to render; chunks pulled in by dynamic import after hydration are excluded, because deferring them is the point of code-splitting. Measuring at networkidle counts the lazy shader chunk and reports ~260KB, failing the app for succeeding.
$vitalsNote: CWV are measured and ENFORCED here for apps declaring a vitals block (F-074, ADR-0066), by PerformanceObserver rather than Lighthouse — which F-049 removed after simulated throttling extrapolated a 71,670ms TBT inside a ~10s trace and provided-throttling returned TBT NaN. Conditions, which the numbers are meaningless without: prefers-reduced-motion:reduce, 4x CDP CPU throttling (Lighthouse mobile convention; the budgets below name no device, so the gate names one), median of 3 runs, 10s observation. Reduced motion is not a test-only mode — it is the designed still-frame state the site ships — and it is the only condition in which TBT terminates at all: with the art animating, TBT DOUBLES when the observation window doubles (2951ms@5s, 6833ms@10s). The honest limit: this does not measure what a motion-enabled visitor experiences. ENFORCED: lcpMs, cls. REPORTED ONLY: tbtMs — the app measures ~950-1050ms against the 200ms budget as this gate runs it (one ~263ms long task at hydration, present even unthrottled; an isolated probe on a quiet machine showed ~680ms), and per the $note above a miss is a work item, never a raised number: it is registered as F-100. When F-100 lands, remove tbtMs from REPORTED_NOT_ENFORCED in web-perf.mjs and it is enforced too. Stability demonstrated across three consecutive gate runs: LCP medians 528/456/488ms, CLS 0/0/0, TBT medians 1008/964/1008ms — the verdict does not flip and each metric prints its own min-max so drift is visible.

apps.name: web
apps.$firstLoadSource: Established by measurement (F-049), not inherited: the dashboard legitimately ships more than the marketing site (React Query, the app shell, next-themes). /signin is the measured route because it is the only dashboard page reachable unauthenticated, and it is the real first paint for every user. Heavy views (Monaco, React Flow) are code-split and must never reach this number — if they do, the split regressed, which is precisely what ADR-0021 asked to be caught.
